title: Stale Reply
summary: Warns before replying to an old message in a thread that has moved on, and shows what was said since.
description: Warns "This was 3 weeks ago and 14 newer messages followed" before you reply, surfaces the newest related messages (and any that already settled it, like "fixed in 2.4.1"), and offers to reply to the latest or quote the original.
catches: Replies to messages older than staleAfter (default 7 days) with at least minNewer newer messages (default 10)
Newer related messages: direct replies, same author or shared keywords
Messages that look like they already resolved it
limits: Relatedness is keyword-based and can miss or over-include
"Resolved" detection is a guess from wording
a11y: Notice is a region with an aria-label; summary in a polite live region
Newer messages expand with aria-expanded/aria-controls; collapsed content is inert
stops: Replied to a thread that moved on
